findings.description: Dora (Dorothea) Dobrotić and Franjo (Franciscus) Korotaj had a son Jacobus (Jakob) Korotaj, born 3 April 1871 and baptised in the parish of Križovljan Radovečki, Varaždin, Croatia (the index gives the baptism as 3 April 1871); the family lived at Lovrečan. The index spells the surname Korota.
supporting_sources: Croatia, Church Books, 1516-1994 — index entry for Jacobus Korota, baptised 3 Apr 1871 at Križovljan Radovečki, Roman Catholic, parents Franciscus Korota and Dorothea Dobrotić (ark:/61903/1:1:QKMG-HJFG; mother persona ark:/61903/1:1:QKMG-HJF5)

Križovljan Radovečki baptism register, 1871, entry 28 (page image ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-L99C-YW38), read directly: Jacobus, filius legitimus, Franciscus Korotaj et Dorothea Dobrotić conj. pleb., Lovrečan No. 4, born 3 April 1871
